meta.name: Starroom Studio UI DNA v1
meta.description: Modern professional photo workstation with restrained futuristic glass accents. Modern Studio 75% + Future Glass 25%, optimized so UI effects do not compete with RAW/GPU/AI workloads.

color.palette_type: analogous cool spectrum with pink-lavender accent entry and neutral charcoal foundation

primary.role: primary interactive accent, active controls, focus states

secondary.role: secondary accent for AI, masks, selected highlights and information

accent.role: brand emphasis, Look Engine, Reference Match and premium/future-facing interactions

neutral.usage: Neutral surfaces dominate the editor. Accent colors never become the background of the image canvas.

surface.card: Theme-aware opaque/semi-translucent surface one level above background
surface.elevated: Theme-aware surface with 1px highlight border; blur only when performance policy permits

color.contrast_strategy: Photo-first neutral surroundings, strong text readability, restrained chromatic accents; body text must meet WCAG AA.

font_families.heading: Segoe UI Variable, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif
font_families.body: Segoe UI Variable, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

typography.font_style_notes: Windows-native modern humanist UI typography. Numeric controls use tabular/monospaced numerals for stable alignment.

spacing.content_density: comfortable-compact; professional workstation density without cramped Lightroom-like stacking
spacing.section_rhythm: 8px inner control rhythm, 12-16px component group rhythm, 20-24px panel section rhythm

layout.grid_system: desktop application shell: collapsible left library + central canvas + hybrid right inspector + collapsible bottom filmstrip
layout.max_content_width: window-bound; central canvas receives all surplus width
layout.columns: 3 primary desktop regions with central flexible column

breakpoints.compact: <1280px: auto-collapse left library first, reduce right-panel width
breakpoints.wide: >=1920px: allow wider inspector and persistent filmstrip

layout.alignment_tendency: strict grid for tools, visually isolated photo canvas, selective floating controls over canvas

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px neutral/highlight borders; active/focus border may use accent gradient edge
shape.divider_style: 1px low-contrast neutral divider, never bright white

elevation.shadow_style: soft restrained depth; avoid large diffuse shadows over persistent panels
elevation.depth_cues: surface luminance, thin highlight border, limited blur, restrained shadow, overlap

iconography.style: line icons at rest, filled or line+filled hybrid when selected
iconography.preferred_set: Lucide-compatible coherent icon family or custom SVGs derived from one geometry system

motion.entrance_pattern: opacity + 2-6px translate or subtle scale 0.98->1 for floating surfaces
motion.philosophy: functional, restrained, cancellation-friendly. Editing responsiveness always outranks decorative motion.

components.button_style: 8px radius, neutral by default, gradient reserved for primary Export/AI/Look actions; icon buttons use hover surface rather than full chrome
components.input_style: compact 32-36px height; numeric inputs use tabular numerals; strong keyboard focus ring
components.card_style: mostly flat sections; floating cards may use translucent glass surface with thin border
components.navigation_pattern: top application navigation + collapsible left library + right icon category rail and accordion content
components.modal_style: centered or anchored glass dialog; backdrop blur kept low and disabled in Performance mode
components.list_style: dense thumbnail/list hybrid with 36-44px row targets and selected accent edge
components.component_notes: Slider uses accent-filled left track (B). On hover/drag, knob shows compact floating numeric value (C). Simple/Pro toggle remembers prior mode, first launch defaults Simple.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: professional darkroom fused with a restrained future imaging workstation
aesthetic.era_influence: late-2020s productivity software with softened glass accents

visual_language.ornamentation: subtle accents; glass and gradients used as hierarchy signals rather than decoration everywhere
visual_language.whitespace_usage: moderate; dense enough for pro tools, spacious around major section boundaries
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: central image dominates; left/right UI deliberately lower contrast
visual_language.focal_strategy: single hero element: the photograph; accent gradient used for selected/AI/creative actions
visual_language.contrast_level: medium-high for controls, low-to-medium for persistent chrome
visual_language.texture_usage: clean surfaces; no noise texture on the image canvas

composition.hierarchy_method: spatial isolation + typography + selective accent color
composition.balance_type: asymmetric workstation layout balanced by central canvas
composition.flow_direction: library/selection left -> image center -> tools right -> filmstrip bottom
composition.grouping_strategy: icon category -> accordion group -> individual control
composition.negative_space_role: protects image focus and separates editing concepts

imagery.photo_treatment: editor must never tint/decorate the actual canvas output; UI surrounds but does not cosmetically modify preview
imagery.illustration_style: minimal line/filled iconography, no cartoon illustration in pro editing surfaces
imagery.graphic_elements: brand gradient, restrained soft glows, mask overlays, histograms and curves
imagery.pattern_usage: none on editing canvas; minimal grid/checkerboard only where semantically required
imagery.image_shape: photo uses true aspect ratio; thumbnails use mild 6-8px rounding where not color-critical

interaction_feel.feedback_style: immediate and precise with subtle accent illumination
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: surface lift/brightness + icon/slider accent; slider shows floating numeric bubble
interaction_feel.loading_style: inline progress, skeleton only for library metadata; image tasks display cancellable progress
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: moderate-low during editing, moderate in AI/Look/Reference flows

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: concise, technical when needed, supportive without being chatty
brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: direct imperative: Export, Match Look, Create Mask, Denoise
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: clear next action with one short explanation
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: specific, actionable, preserves user confidence by naming what failed and what remains safe

overview.effect_intensity: moderate visual presence, low computational cost
overview.fallback_strategy: Auto quality mode reduces real backdrop blur, shadows, animation density and preview refresh before compromising image quality
overview.primary_technology: CSS compositor-friendly opacity/transform effects; limited backdrop-filter; no decorative WebGL/Canvas effects

background_effects.type: static-subtle-gradient only on brand/AI surfaces; neutral on editing canvas
background_effects.description: Brand gradient may appear in compact decorative bands or selected surfaces, never as an animated full-window background.

particle_systems.description: No decorative particles in the editor.

shader_effects.description: GPU budget is reserved for image rendering, not decorative UI shaders.

scroll_morphing.description: Desktop panels use direct transitions, not scroll storytelling.

text_effects.description: Optional brand/logo gradient only; tool labels remain flat.

cursor_effects.description: Use native pointer semantics for precision.

image_effects.description: No cosmetic UI effect is applied to the actual photo preview.

params.reveal_animation: simple opacity when replacing preview quality level

params.blur_radius: 0px persistent panels; 8-16px floating surfaces in High; 4-8px Balanced; 0px Performance
params.border_treatment: 1px rgba highlight plus optional accent edge on selected creative/AI surfaces

svg_animations.description: Selected icons may morph/fill subtly; no continuous decorative SVG loops.

params.animation_method: CSS transform/opacity or short path state change

visual_effects.composite_notes: The editor should visually read as 75% Modern Studio and 25% Future Glass. Actual expensive blur is restricted to transient floating surfaces. Auto/Balanced/Performance modes may reduce UI effects without changing image-render correctness.
